hitPoints.atHigherLevels: 1d8 (or 5) + your Constitution modifier per rogue level after 1st

options.description: Leather armor, two daggers, and thieves' tools

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Choose two skills or thieves' tools you are proficient in; your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses them. At 6th level, you gain two more.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.description: Once per turn, you can deal extra damage to one creature you hit with an attack with a finesse or ranged weapon; you must have advantage on the attack roll, or an ally within 5 ft of the target and you don't have disadvantage. Damage scales with level (1d6 at 1, 2d6 at 3, etc., up to 10d6 at 19).

features.name: Thieves' Cant
features.description: You know Thieves' Cant, a secret mix of dialect, jargon, and code that allows you to hide messages in seemingly normal conversation. Only another creature that knows Thieves' Cant understands such messages.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.description: You can take a bonus action to Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

features.name: Roguish Archetype
features.description: You choose an archetype: Thief or Assassin.

features.name: Steady Aim (Optional 3rd)
features.description: As a bonus action, give yourself advantage on the next attack roll you make this turn, but your speed becomes 0 until the end of the turn.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two by 1. Max 20.

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.description: When an attacker you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can use your reaction to halve the attack's damage against you.

features.name: Expertise (Level 6)
features.description: Choose 2 more proficiencies (skills or thieves' tools) for Expertise.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: When subjected to an effect that allows a DEX save for half damage, you take no damage on success and half on failure (instead of half on success).

features.name: Reliable Talent
features.description: Whenever you make an ability check that lets you add your proficiency bonus, you treat any d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

features.name: Blindsense
features.description: If you are able to hear, you are aware of the location of any hidden or invisible creature within 10 ft of you.

features.name: Slippery Mind
features.description: You gain proficiency in WIS saving throws.

features.name: Elusive
features.description: Attack rolls against you can't benefit from more than one of the following: advantage, the attacker being within 5 ft of you, or the attacker being invisible.

features.name: Stroke of Luck
features.description: You have an uncanny knack for succeeding when you need to. If your attack misses a target within range, you can turn the miss into a hit. Alternatively, if you fail an ability check, you can treat the d20 roll as a 20. Once you use this, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

subclasses.name: Arcane Trickster

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.description: +1d6 extra damage on attack with advantage (or target adjacent to ally + 0 ability cover).

features.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
features.description: Cast Mage Hand with 5x range, you can stow/retrieve an object, open doors, attack bonuses.

features.name: Spellcasting (AT)
features.description: Cast wizard cantrips and 1st level+ spells from wizard list.

features.name: Magical Ambush
features.description: Creatures have disadvantage on save vs. spells from hiding.

features.name: Versatile Trickster
features.description: Use bonus action Mage Hand to distract and attack with sneak attack.

features.name: Elusive
features.description: No attack roll has advantage against you.

subclasses.description: You learn spells and develop techniques of arcane trickery. Focus on illusion and enchantment magic.

subclasses.name: Assassin
subclasses.description: You focus your training on dealing death with precision. You become expert at the ambush, the sudden kill.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency with the disguise kit and the poisoner's kit.

features.name: Assassinate
features.description: You are at your deadliest when you get the drop on your enemies. You have advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn in combat yet. On any hit against such a creature, it is a critical hit. If the target is surprised, it must make a CON save vs your spell save DC or drop to 0 HP instead of taking damage.

features.name: Infiltration Expertise
features.description: You can create a false identity for yourself; you can adopt it as a disguise. PCM: You can study a persona after 25 + (3 × INT mod) work and adopt it as if it were a disguise (using INT (Investigation) for Deception checks).

features.name: Impostor
features.description: You gain the ability to mimic another person's speech patterns and mannerisms. You need to hear a person speak for at least 1 minute; you can then mimic them for 1 hour, gaining a +10 bonus to Deception checks to convince someone you are that person.

features.name: Death Strike
features.description: If you Assassinate a target that is surprised, double the damage of your attack. If it takes any damage, it must make a CON save vs your spell save DC or have its HP maximum reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken (or fall to 0 HP if the damage is lethal).

subclasses.name: Phantom

features.name: Whispers of the Dead
features.description: Cast Augury and 7th-level Commune with the Dead.

features.name: Wails from Beyond
features.description: Sneak attack deals extra 2d6 necrotic on first attack from stealth.

features.name: Skills of the Ghost
features.description: Mage Hand from invisible position lets you steal without disturbing.

features.name: Souls of the Dead
features.description: Use Wails from Beyond and an extra d6 necrotic per attack.

features.name: Tokens of the Dying
features.description: Capture soul of a slain humanoid; use 1d6 phantom's wails and reaction.

subclasses.description: You channel the spirits of the dead to gain mastery of necrotic magic and stealth.

subclasses.name: Soulknife

features.name: Psionic Power
features.description: Gain 4 psionic energy dice (d6); learn 3 psionic disciplines.

features.name: Psychic Blades
features.description: Bonus action create a bonus psychic weapon attack.

features.name: Homing Strikes
features.description: When you miss, reroll with a psionic die.

features.name: Soul Blades
features.description: Cast Blade of Disorder with PSI dice; AOE psionic attack.

subclasses.description: You forge your mind and weapon into a single tool of destruction. Psionic rogue with psychic blades.

subclasses.name: Thief
subclasses.description: You hone your abilities in areas of rogue's talents that few can match: the quickness of your hands, the resilience of your body, and the art of climbing.

features.name: Fast Hands
features.description: You can take a bonus action to use Sleight of Hand, or use thieves' tools to pick a lock or disarm a trap, or take the Use an Object action.

features.name: Second-Story Work
features.description: You gain climbing speed equal to your walking speed. Falling damage is reduced 0 at level 3, by 10 ft at 9th level, by 20 ft at 13th, by 30 ft at 17th.

features.name: Supreme Sneak
features.description: You have advantage on Stealth checks if you move no more than half your speed on the same turn.

features.name: Thief's Reflexes
features.description: When a creature within 5 ft of you makes an attack roll, you can use your reaction to make a melee attack or use Sleight of Hand against that creature.

features.name: Use Magic Device (Optional 13th-level feature)
features.description: You gain proficiency with one of the following skills your choice: Arcana; you add your proficiency bonus to ability checks made to determine the properties and command words of magic items, and your attunement slot count increases by 1.

features.name: Thief's Reflexes (Improved)
features.description: You can use Thief's Reflexes any number of times per rest.

subclasses.name: Asesino
subclasses.description: Te especializas en la emboscada, la muerte súbita.

features.name: Competencias adicionales
features.description: Competencia en Kit de disfraz y Kit de envenenador.

features.name: Asesinar
features.description: Ventaja y crítico automático contra criaturas que aún no han actuado; sorpresa: salva CON o a 0 PG.

features.name: Pericia en infiltración
features.description: Creas una identidad falsa, trabajas 25 + 3 × INT mod horas para adoptarla.

features.name: Impostor
features.description: Escuchas a una persona 1 minuto, luego la imitas durante 1 hora (Engaño +10).

features.name: Golpe mortal
features.description: Asesina a objetivo sorprendido: duplica daño; salva CON o reduce pg max al daño recibido.

subclasses.name: Ladrón
subclasses.description: Perfeccionas tus habilidades de pícaro: rapidez de manos, resistencia del cuerpo y arte del trepar.

features.name: Manos rápidas
features.description: Acción adicional: Juego de manos, Herramientas de ladrón o Usar un objeto.

features.name: Trabajo de segundo piso
features.description: Velocidad de trepar igual a caminar; reducción de daño por caída.

features.name: Sigilo supremo
features.description: Ventaja en Sigilo si te mueves a la mitad o menos de tu velocidad este turno.

features.name: Reflejos del ladrón
features.description: Reacción: ataque cuerpo a cuerpo o Juego de manos contra criatura a 1,5 m que ataque.
